title: UK climate minister Katie White: COP31 must respond to ‘really scary’ science - Carbon Brief
gist: UK climate minister Katie White says COP31 in Antalya must respond to 'really scary' science, backing electrification, methane and forest action while defending the Jackdaw gas approval, a reduced £6bn climate-finance pledge and Chancellor John Healey's affordability-focused energy pivot. She says the Hormuz crisis drove record UK uptake of solar, heat pumps and EVs.
